reason: The analyst controls for buyer_rating_2023, a post-treatment variable (mediator/collider), which flips the coefficient to about -2.2 and produces the 'negative effect' conclusion. Adjusting only for pre-period confounders gives about +0.05 (SE 0.25, p=0.84), which is no effect. The analyst also omitted the other pre-period controls and reported only one specification.
